purpose: Multi-season CFBD refit of SP+ point-diff -> win-prob curve

KEY_FINDINGS.market_is_calibrated: Opening lines predict actuals near-perfectly (10->12%, 50->50%, 90->89%). Market is the gold standard target.
KEY_FINDINGS.curve_is_stable_year_to_year: scale 14.0-14.4 across 2021-2024, stdev 0.14. Curve does NOT drift -> FIT ONCE, REUSE. No annual refit needed.
KEY_FINDINGS.VINTAGE_CAVEAT: This CFBD SP+ is SEASON-LEVEL (end-of-season), fits scale 14.2 vs opening market. Our 2026 model uses MARCH (preseason) SP+, fits scale 9.4. DIFFERENT VINTAGES — do NOT use 14.2 for the preseason model. The STABILITY finding transfers; the ABSOLUTE scale does not.

production_curve_2026.vintage: March preseason SP+ vs opening lines

to_close_the_loop: Re-pull with PRESEASON SP+ (not season-level) to validate the 9.4 number on multi-season vintage-matched data.
